Sudden trouble speaking or understanding words… I don’t think so, not in the way you probably mean.

Like, I haven’t had a moment where I suddenly couldn’t get words out at all, or where someone was talking and it just turned into nonsense. Sometimes I can tell I’m getting overwhelmed because there’s too much happening at once — tickets, customers, someone asking me for change, someone else needing a card run — but I don’t know if I’d call it sudden intense fear. It’s not like I think I’m dying or anything. It’s more confusion, or getting stuck, and then the fear comes when I notice I can’t move on and everybody else notices too.\n\nDoctor: After one of these episodes, do you remember everything that happened during it?\n\nPatient: Mostly, yeah… I remember it, but it’s kind of jumbled, if that makes sense. I remember the wrongness of it, like I knew the steps but they were all out of order in my head. So I don’t think I lose the whole thing.
